blocks.text: Zscaler recommends that you use the Authentication Service Admin Portal to configure primary and secondary external identity providers (IdPs). Authentication Service supports both SAML and OpenID configurations. Contact Zscaler Support to subscribe to Authentication Service.
This article provides information on configuring OpenID single sign-on (SSO) for Okta.
Before you configure OpenID, make sure to configure OpenID for Okta with the following settings:

blocks.item: Select Web Application as the application type.
Use https://<Zscaler ITDR Instance Name>/oauth as the sign-in redirect URI.
Step 1: Obtain the Client ID and Client Secret from Okta
Log in to the Okta portal as an administrator.
Select the application that you created while configuring OpenID for Okta.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secrets.
